description: Summarise the pull requests the Plutus GitHub App opened for this account from savings recommendations (automated fixes) in a window, default the last 90 days, at most 365: how many were opened, merged, closed without merging by the team, closed by Plutus itself (withdrawn, superseded or replaced, not a rejection) and are still open (each counted once, in its current state), how many were opened automatically versus requested by an admin, the median hours from opening to merge, a per-month series by the month each was opened, the change kinds, and the 10 most recent (number, GitHub URL, state, dates, estimated saving). Plutus never merges a pull request: a person on the account does. Every money figure is an estimate, in USD cents (the response's `currency`): the savings recommendation's estimated monthly saving as it stood when the pull request opened, a potential monthly saving once the change is applied. A merged change saves nothing until it is applied (for example by a Terraform apply), and Plutus does not check that it was. Never call it realised, verified or guaranteed saving. Each recommendation is priced once per total; `merged_priced`/`open_priced` say how many pull requests the totals cover; a null total means none was priced, not zero. Jobs that never opened a pull request are not counted. `available` false means automated fixes are not offered to this account. Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/remediation/impact.

days.description: Window length in days, ending now (default 90)

name: get_remediation_impact
